metallum.options.improved_lighting.name: Advanced Lighting
metallum.options.improved_lighting.toolt: Enables L3 clustered colored direct lighting for terrain and entities. The L2 material renderer remains automatic; failed admission safely falls back to Vanilla lighting. Changes require a restart.
metallum.options.lighting_preset.name: Lighting Preset
metallum.options.lighting_preset.tooltip: Sets the quality and GPU work-budget for the advanced lighting system: shadow cascades, voxel clipmap levels, and cluster capacity. Applies only when Advanced Lighting is on. Changes require a restart.
metallum.options.frame_interpolation.too: Off / Auto (Experimental). Requires fixed MetalFX Temporal upscaling, a 60 Hz or faster display, and a supported macOS 26+ device. The renderer safely stays real-frame-only when unavailable.
metallum.options.metalfx_upscaling.name: MetalFX Upscaling
metallum.options.metalfx_upscaling.toolt: Disables upscaling. 3D scene renders at native display resolution (%dx%d).
Enables MetalFX Spatial upscaling with Dynamic Resolution Scaling (DRS) targeting 60 FPS (16.66ms). UI stays native (%dx%d).
Enables MetalFX Temporal upscaling with Dynamic Resolution Scaling (DRS) targeting 60 FPS (16.66ms). UI stays native (%dx%d).
metallum.options.metalfx_resolution_over: Displays render resolution, render-loop FPS, and the rate and total of generated frames confirmed as presented on screen.
metallum.options.metalfx_spatial_scaling: Native rendering: %s×%s (100%%). MetalFX Spatial Scaling is disabled.
Auto selected native rendering: %s×%s (100%%). Measurements favor native rendering for SDR; EDR also stays native conservatively.
Auto selected %s. World: %s×%s → %s×%s. Preset: %s%% per axis; actual: %s%% × %s%%, or %s%% of native pixels. The interface remains at full resolution.
Native rendering: %s×%s (100%%). MetalFX Spatial Scaling is unavailable or was disabled by the safe runtime fallback.
World: %s×%s → %s×%s. Preset: %s%% per axis; actual: %s%% × %s%%, or %s%% of native pixels. The interface remains at full resolution.
metallum.options.metalfx_temporal_scalin: Native rendering: %s×%s (100%%). Temporal Upscaling is disabled.
Native rendering: %s×%s (100%%). Temporal Upscaling is unavailable or was disabled by the safe runtime fallback.

World: %s×%s → %s×%s. Preset: %s%% per axis; actual: %s%% × %s%%, or %s%% of native pixels. Native Apple MetalFX Temporal reconstruction uses depth, motion, reset, and reactive-mask inputs; the interface remains at full resolution.
metallum.options.voxel_preview_mode.name: L5 Voxel Clipmap Preview
metallum.options.voxel_preview_mode.tool: Shows a fail-isolated XY slice of L5 brick data acknowledged by the native GPU command encoder. Magenta means that the current toroidal slot has not been uploaded yet.
metallum.options.voxel_preview_level.too: Selects clipmap level 0–2. Values unavailable in the active preset are clamped safely.
metallum.options.voxel_preview_slice.too: Selects a local Z slice. Values beyond the selected level are clamped safely.
metallum.options.voxel_debug_checksum.to: Advanced-only diagnostic. Periodically computes a non-blocking checksum of the finest GPU voxel clipmap and publishes it as voxel_clipmaps.debug_checksum in timing telemetry. It does not add an on-screen preview. Vanilla allocates and executes nothing. Changes require a restart.
metallum.options.hdr_enabled.name: HDR Enabled
metallum.options.hdr_enabled.tooltip: Enables HDR output. Changes to this setting require a restart.
metallum.options.source_encoding.name: Source Encoding
metallum.options.source_encoding.tooltip: Source color space encoding. Changes to this setting require a restart.
metallum.options.hdr_strength.name: HDR Strength
metallum.options.hdr_strength.tooltip: Multiplier for HDR scene brightness (range 0% to 200%). Applied dynamically.
metallum.options.bloom_strength.name: Bloom Strength
metallum.options.bloom_strength.tooltip: Strength of the FP16 coverage-weighted bloom pass. Applied dynamically.
metallum.options.diagnostic_pattern.name: Full-Screen HDR Calibration Pattern
metallum.options.diagnostic_pattern.tool: Replaces the entire frame with an HDR calibration pattern. Press Esc to exit the pattern.
metallum.options.experimental_fp16.name: Experimental FP16 Scene Path
metallum.options.experimental_fp16.toolt: Enables the FP16 scene pipeline for enhanced modes. Changes require a restart.
